map.为什么曲线锯斜切会跑偏？: Why does a curve saw drift when beveling?
map.曲线锯条窄而柔，斜切时刃口受力不均、侧向分力使锯路偏移。模型取 K=0.04 乘: A curve-saw blade is narrow and flexible; when beveling, uneven tooth load and the lateral force shift the kerf. The model uses K=0.04 multiplied by the blade factor (heavy tooth 0.5 / standard 1.0 / thin tooth 1.8) then by blade travel and sinθ to estimate drift; circular and miter saws have rigid blades so it is negligible. Compensate by locking the orbital action off, feeding slowly against a guide rail, and raising the base-plate compensation angle.
